concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-business-accounts-verification-overview]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Business Accounts KYC/capability process for asynchronous checks, data-review triggers, LEM-v3/v4 verification deadlines and permission loss.
warnings: The standard 30-/60-day deadlines are conditional and can be shortened or removed; an active deadline may preserve already allowed capabilities but is not KYC approval.
The illustrative account-holder response combines allowed=true, verificationStatus=invalid and a capability-not-allowed error; do not infer a universal state transition or actual user outcome.
This page gives no country-eligibility table or universal legal-entity permission; account-holder setup/capability requests do not prove Business Account opening or transfer success.
